subject: Exec Orbit Update — week of 2027-06-01: wins, chokepoints, asks
messages:
From: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
To: exec-team@redwood.com; Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>; Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 1 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Exec Orbit Update — week of 2027-06-01: wins, chokepoints, asks

Good morning team — quick weekly readout ahead of QBR prep. Short bullets so this is skimmable.

Wins:
- Hosted API throughput optimizations landed in prod (6% p99 drop on text-gen across 16k seq).
- Closed NimbleCloud POC — they signed a 6-month pilot; legal routing is in flight.
- Console: token-level billing beta looks stable; a handful of customers are exercising it.

Chokepoints / risks:
- Dedicated capacity autoscaler has intermittent flapping under burst scenarios — SRE is prioritizing a fix but we need to set a customer communication plan in case a few customers see degraded throughput.
- Procurement for Private deployment (Greenbridge) is stalling on SOC2 evidence (they requested log retention proofs). Sales is awaiting a bundled evidence packet.
- One of the near-term model rollouts (quantized 13B) is regressing on a prompt slice used by CS; research is iterating.

Asks (what I need from leadership this week):
- Karthik: priority on a comms note for customers tied to autoscaler flapping (one-paragraph + fallback messaging). Target: EOD Wed.
- Jonas: can you surface a short SOC2 evidence pack (logs, retention policy summary) for Greenbridge by Thu? Sales needs it to avoid a procurement stall.
- Marissa: compile a 1-slide win/ask for QBR focusing on unit cost improvements and any open operational risks.

Attachments: pipeline_snapshot.csv (current ARR-tracked prospects), QBR_cheatsheet.pdf (one-pager ask template).

Thanks — I’ve flagged owners inline. If nothing urgent, I’ll fold updates into the QBR playbook doc.

— Lauren
Lauren Bishop | VP, Product Operations
Redwood Inference
lauren.bishop@redwood.com

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>; exec-team@redwood.com
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 1 Jun 2027 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Exec Orbit Update — week of 2027-06-01: wins, chokepoints, asks

Thanks Lauren — noted. I’ll draft the comms note and ping SRE for technical fallback language. One quick question: do we want the note to call out specific customers affected or keep it generic?

Karthik
Director, Customer Reliability
